comparison.objective: Pipe a joined ridged shell border on a cake; the candidate calibrates and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous pressure control synchronized with nozzle motion and icing deposition versus discrete coaxial driver/wrench manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Scores valid deposited length, shell shape, ridges, cleanliness, and released dispenser; candidate scores angle tolerance, locking, repeated return, and clearance.
